newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannonplast firms in flat Budapest market.
newsitem.headline: Pannonplast firms in flat Budapest market.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange closed little changed as reflected by the BUX index as the few soaring papers could not substantially change the market's flat pattern, traders said.
"No major changes occurred regarding the market as a whole," said Peter Lencs of MKB Securities.
The BUX index ended at 3,539.46 points, up 10.32.
"The wait-and-see attitude of the market has remained unchanged. Since news of a potential rate hike in the U.S. was released the market has been stagnant," Lencs said.
A few shares, however, outperformed the market.
Inter-Europa Bank strengthened 2,450 forints to close at 37,500 forints in slack trade and traders did not see any fundamental reason behind the strong rise.
Unlike in the case of plastics company Pannonplast which firmed almost three percent to end at 5,180 forints after the announcement of increasing share capital in three of its units.

The price of compensation coupons which soared recently propelled partly by speculative purchases, collapsed today justifying earlier opinions that its recent price rise was not supported by fundamental reasons.
The coupons closed at 535 forints, down 136 forints or 20.27 percent.
